 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Steve MacLaughlin • 
 Published October 31, 2026 • 
 Updated 6 hours ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Steve MacLaughlin has your forecast for today, Saturday, Oct. 31, 2026
 Halloween was quite unsettled for some folks, but the rest of the evening will only feature some spotty, fast-moving storms on a brisk easterly breeze. 
 This is an improvement because the heavy, widespread rain has slowed down…building in overnight and then happening on & off all day Sunday & Monday. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 We continue with a Coastal Flood Advisory (moderate flooding) for everywhere except the Upper Keys, where a Warning (major flooding) remains in effect. 
 The next two high tides for Virginia Key are 1:22am and 2:05pm; for Key West are 1:52 a.m. and 4:02 p.m. 
 Rip Currents continue Sunday along with a Broward High Surf Advisory for 5-8 ft breakers. Boaters continue with a Small Craft Advisory Sunday. 
 Don't forget to Fall Back tonight before bed. Sunrise Sunday is 6:30am; Sunset is 5:39pm
